items.titleZh: 2026年美国大奖赛首日F1所了解到的所有信息
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯推迟ADUO F1引擎升级，本田在新加坡大奖赛后的分析仍令人困惑。
items.originalTitle: Everything we learned on day one of F1's 2026 US GP
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯推迟了ADUO F1引擎的升级，原计划在美国大奖赛上引入，但升级的动力单元尚未准备好。
梅赛德斯希望在确信这是真正的进步时才引入ADUO引擎，但这引发了关于车队汽车和引擎包未来发展的更多问题。
本田在新加坡大奖赛后的分析表明，其升级的涡轮增压器存在明显的弱点。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes has delayed the introduction of the ADUO F1 engine, originally planned for the US Grand Prix, due to the unavailability of the upgraded power unit.
Mercedes wants to introduce the ADUO engine only when it is convinced it is a proper step forward, which raises further questions about the future development of the team's car and engine package.
Honda's analysis after the Singapore GP indicates a clear weakness in understanding how its upgraded turbocharger is performing.
